rationale: Saudi pipeline closure after Iraq drone attack raises oil market concerns; Rubio signals shift in Ecuador drug war strategy toward allied cooperation; US designates Ecuadorian gang as terrorist group.

top_events.title: Saudi Arabia shuts key oil pipeline after drone attack launched from Iraq

top_events.summary: Secretary of State visits Ecuador and signals new approach favoring allied cooperation over unilateral strikes after campaign against narco-terrorists.

top_events.summary: Trump administration designates Los Tiguerones gang as terrorist group over narcotics trafficking, seeking extra Congressional funding to dismantle organization.
